news.title: 5 bizarre reasons international students have been refused visas
news.summary_en: With visa refusals surging across major study destinations, The PIE has gathered together the most bonkers reasons government agents have given for rejecting applications.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Access for whom?
news.summary_en: As students across Africa battle with visa refusals, it's no longer enough to simply talk about widening access to higher education. Action must be taken to help students take up the opportunities they have earned, writes Bimpe Femi-Oyewo
news.author: Bimpe Femi-Oyewo

news.title: IDP weighs up $573.3m private equity takeover bid
news.summary_en: IDP Education is considering a renewed proposal from Blackstone, after the private equity giant submitted a sweetened bid worth $573.3 million.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: UK student visa applications down 31% as Russell Group warns of volatility
news.summary_en: UK student visa applications fell by 31% in October compared with the same month last year, prompting fresh warnings over continued volatility in the international student market.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: AI can improve test fairness, but human judgement remains vital
news.summary_en: Speakers at the Pearson HE Admissions Summit said universities should ask why a test uses AI, expect openness about how it works, and keep humans accountable for decisions.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Migration is essential to education and the Australian way of life
news.summary_en: Australia risks losing more than talent and economic opportunity as migration restrictions threaten multiculturalism, argues Jessica Gallagher, deputy vice chancellor international and external engagement at Adelaide University.
news.author: Jessica Gallagher

news.title: International business student decline could cost UK economy £4.2bn
news.summary_en: The UK economy could experience a £4.2 billion loss if international business students' numbers continue to fall and return to their 2019/20 level, a new report reveals.
news.author: Jenna O'Flynn

news.title: South Asia needs more than a recruitment strategy. It needs a market development strategy
news.summary_en: International education providers invest heavily in reaching South Asian students. But their long-term success may depend on what they build in the region, not simply how many applications they generate, says Mukesh Dhamala.
news.author: Mukesh Dhamala

news.title: Interest in US surges as study destination up 40% after midterms
news.summary_en: Just one week on from the US midterm elections, new data shows international students’ interest in studying in the US has jumped by 40%, following two years of decline.
news.author: Jenna O'Flynn

news.title: Exclusive: London Met returns to Bangladesh, warns of UKVI fallout
news.summary_en: The university had paused recruitment from Bangladesh as the sector braced for tighter Basic Compliance Assessment (BCA) requirements, but deputy vice-chancellor Gary Davies has confirmed that improved data now supports a return.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Global PBSA leaders outline China’s new student-centric era
news.summary_en: The global international student housing and education sectors stand at a critical inflection point, marked by a structural shift from supply shortages to an oversupplied market in key university hubs.
news.author: Rongrong Walker

news.title: AIEC 2026: Australia rethinks its international education promise
news.summary_en: At its 40th conference in Sydney, the Australian sector confronted visa uncertainty, global competition and the need to make a more credible case to students and the public.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: ASEAN-UK higher education partnerships must reflect local priorities
news.summary_en: ASEAN and UK higher education leaders have called for more locally driven partnerships, backed by clear regulation and funding, as universities look to deepen collaboration on skills, research and AI.
news.author: Beth Kennedy
